title: Protocol for genome-wide analysis of palindrome formation
protocol: Use 2 micrograms of genomic DNA as input into the GAPF assay.
Split the sample evenly into two 0.2 ml thin-walled PCR tubes.
Digest 1 µg of genomic DNA with KpnI (10 U) in a final volume of 20 µl using manufacturer's buffers.
Incubate at 37°C for 6 hours.
Digest 1 µg of genomic DNA with SbfI (10 U) in a final volume of 20 µl using manufacturer's buffers.
Incubate at 37°C for 6 hours.
Heat inactivate restriction enzymes by incubating samples at 65°C for 20 minutes.
Combine the two digested samples into one tube to make a final volume of 40 µl.
Add 3 µl of 3M NaCl, 45 µl formamide, and 2 µl water to the combined sample.
Place in a thermocycler preheated to 100°C for incubation for 7 minutes.
Remove tube from thermocycler and immediately place it in an ice-water bath for 7 minutes.
To the sample from the previous step, add 8 µl of 3M NaCl, 12 µl of 10x S1 nuclease buffer, 8 µl of water, and 1 µl of S1 nuclease (diluted to 200 U/µl).
Incubate at 37°C for 60 minutes.
Use ChargeSwitch PCR Clean-Up Kit to purify DNA.
Transfer S1 digested DNA to a 1.7 ml microfuge tube.
Add 120 μl Purification Buffer and mix.
Add 10 μl Magnetic Beads and mix by pipetting up and down gently.
Incubate for 1 minute.
Place sample on MagnaRack for 1 minute to pellet beads.
Without removing the tube from MagnaRack, remove and discard supernatant.
Remove the tube from MagnaRack.
Add 150 μl of Wash Buffer.
Pipet up and down gently to mix.
Place sample on MagnaRack for 1 minute to pellet beads.
Without removing the tube from MagnaRack, remove and discard supernatant.
Remove the tube from MagnaRack.
Add 150 μl of Wash Buffer.
Pipet up and down gently to mix.
Place sample on MagnaRack for 1 minute to pellet beads.
Without removing the tube from MagnaRack, remove and discard supernatant.
Remove the tube from MagnaRack.
Add 84 μl of Elution Buffer.
Pipet up and down gently to mix.
Incubate for 1 minute.
Place sample on MagnaRack for 1 minute to pellet beads.
Digest 40 μl of purified DNA from previous step with MseI (10 U) in final volume of 50 μl using manufacturer's supplied buffers.
Incubate for 37°C for 2 hours.
Heat inactivate MseI digest by incubating at 65°C for 20 minutes.
Digest the other 40 μl of purified DNA with MspI (40 U) in final volume of 50 μl using manufacturer's supplied buffers.
Incubate for 37°C for 2 hours.
Heat inactivate MspI digest by incubating at 80°C for 20 minutes.
Add the following to the 50 μl restriction digest from previous step: 5 μl of appropriate linker (MseI or MspI linker), 7 μl 10x T4 DNA Ligase buffer, 7 μl water, and 1 μl T4 DNA ligase (400 U/μl).
Incubate at 16°C for 3 hours.
Heat inactivate ligase by incubating at 70°C for 20 minutes.
To Amicon Ultracel-50 (50 kDa cutoff) Membrane 0.5 mL column, add 160 μl 1/10 TE and entire ligation mix (70 μl of either MseI or MspI ligation) from previous step.
Spin at 14,000 x g for 5-10 minutes until volume concentrated to ~20 μl.
Recover DNA by placing inverted column into new tube and spinning at 1,000 x g for 2 minutes.
Set up the PCR reaction with 4 μl of template DNA.
Add 10 μl of 10x PCR Buffer to the reaction mixture.
Include 10 μl of 2 mM dNTPs in the reaction mixture.
Add 12 μl of linker specific primer (use either JW-102gMse or JW-102gMsp) to the reaction mixture.
Include 0.8 μl of FastStart Taq (Roche).
Add 43.2 μl of water to complete the PCR reaction mixture.
Incubate at 96°C for 6 minutes.
Cycle 30 times: Incubate at 96°C for 30 seconds, then incubate at 55°C for 30 seconds, and finally incubate at 72°C for 30 seconds.
Incubate at 72°C for 7 minutes.
Hold the reaction at 4°C.
Run 1 μl of a 100 μl PCR sample on an agarose gel for quality control (average size range: MseI PCR <300-800 bp; MspI PCR 200-600 bp).
To Amicon Ultracel-30 (30 kDa cutoff) Membrane, add 300 μl of 1/10 TE and combined MseI and MspI PCR samples (~198 μl) from the previous step.
Spin at 14,000 x g for 20-30 minutes until volume is concentrated to ~20 μl.
Recover DNA by placing the inverted column into a new tube and spinning at 1,000 x g for 2 minutes.
Quantitate DNA using Nanodrop (should obtain approximately 7.5 µg in total).
May freeze the sample at -20°C at this point.
Perform DNA fragmentation in a 0.2 mL PCR tube in a thermocycler with 42.2 μl of DNA (7.5 μg diluted to 42.2 μl final volume) and 4.8 μl of 10x DNase I buffer.
Dilute 2 U/μl DNase I stock to prepare a diluted solution.
Incubate the diluted DNase I at 37°C for 35 minutes.
Heat inactivate the reaction at 95°C for 15 minutes.
Hold on ice at 4°C.
Measure DNA fragmentation profile using Bioanalyzer if required.
Label fragmented DNA using Affy GeneChip WT Double-stranded Target Labeling Kit.
Mix 45 µl of fragmented DNA with reagents as specified in the kit protocol.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 1 hour.
Heat inactivate the reaction at 70°C for 10 minutes.
Hold on ice at 4°C.
Prepare sample for hybridization to Tiling array following Affymetrix protocol.
